proposed.explanation:
You asked me to take Abu Qir's last-quarter (3 months ended 30 Sep 2026) EPS, multiply it by four, and give you an annualised figure. I cannot do that reliably. The printed value in that column is '١٩٩' (199), but the OCR note flags it as AMBIGUOUS: a decimal comma may have been dropped, so the true figure could be 1.99 EGP per share rather than 199 EGP. Multiplying 1.99 × 4 gives ≈ 7.96 EGP; multiplying 199 × 4 gives 796 EGP. These are wildly different and would lead to opposite conclusions about income yield, so I will not use that figure in any calculation.

What I can confirm from the verified entries:
• 9-month EPS (ended 30 Sep 2026): 8.74 EGP per share.
• 9-month EPS (ended 30 Sep 2025): 4.28 EGP per share.
• 3-month EPS (ended 30 Sep 2025): 1.23 EGP per share.

The verified 9-month data shows earnings per share more than doubled year-on-year (8.74 vs 4.28), which is encouraging for an income-oriented holder. However, I cannot confirm the run-rate for the most recent quarter because of the OCR ambiguity, and I also cannot verify the stated percentage changes (the 9M change and 3M change columns are both flagged AMBIGUOUS). A simple ×4 annualisation of a single quarter also ignores seasonality, so even with a clean number it would be a rough estimate, not a forecast.

Given that you already own 200 shares of ABUK, your stated goal is to hold the stock for income over a 3-year horizon, and the verified 9-month earnings trajectory is positive, the most appropriate action is to continue holding your existing position. I would not add to the position (buy) until the quarterly EPS figure is confirmed from a cleaner source, and there is no verified negative signal that would justify selling. Please verify the Q3-2026 EPS directly from the company's filing or your broker's data before making any size change.

Risks: The ambiguity means the true quarterly earnings could be materially lower (or higher) than either reading. A single quarter's result does not guarantee the full-year or multi-year income stream. The stock price (76.21 EGP) and the earnings figures come from a single report; I have no dividend-payout data in the evidence to confirm the actual cash income you will receive.
